constraints.ocl:
context Reservation
inv: (self.copy <> null) and (self.expiryDate = self.requestDate)

context Category
inv: (self.books->exists(x | x.publishYear > 0)) and (self.name <> null)

context Book
inv: self.publishYear >= 2 and self.publishYear <= 15

context Book
inv: self.pages >= 20 and self.pages <= 95

context Loan
inv: self.dueDate <> null implies self.startDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.returnDate <> null implies self.startDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.dueDate <> null implies self.returnDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.dueDate <> null

context Fine
inv: (self.loan <> null) and (not(self.loan <> null))

context Book
inv: ((self.library.maxLoanDays < 10) and (self.isbn.size() <= 36)) and (not((self.library.maxLoanDays < 10) and (self.isbn.size() <= 36)))

context Book
inv: ((self.library.maxLoanDays < 10) and (self.pages mod 2 = 1)) and (not((self.library.maxLoanDays < 10) and (self.pages mod 2 = 1)))

context Book
inv: ((self.publishYear < 100) and (self.authors->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))) and (not((self.publishYear < 100) and (self.authors->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))))

context Book
inv: ((self.publishYear > 1) and (self.copies->forAll(v | v.barcode <> ''))) and (not((self.publishYear > 1) and (self.copies->forAll(v | v.barcode <> ''))))

context Category
inv: (self.books->any(x | x.publishYear <= 100) <> null) and (not(self.books->any(x | x.publishYear <= 100) <> null))

context Loan
inv: (self.returnDate <> null and self.dueDate <> null) and (not(self.returnDate <> null and self.dueDate <> null))

context Book
inv: ((self.publishYear >= 1) and (self.authors->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))) and (not((self.publishYear >= 1) and (self.authors->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))))

context Branch
inv: (self.library <> null) and (not(self.library <> null))

context Library
inv: (self.members->exists(x | x.name <> '')) and (not(self.members->exists(x | x.name <> '')))

context Book
inv: (self.authors->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (not(self.authors->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null))

context Loan
inv: ((self.returnDate <> null) = (self.startDate <> null)) and (not((self.returnDate <> null) = (self.startDate <> null)))
